title: Cardinals QB Carson Beck misses practice with back spasms; Mike LaFleur says team is preparing for Josh Johnson start

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals QB Carson Beck misses practice with back spasms; Mike LaFleur says team is preparing for Josh Johnson start
sources.description: LaFleur said the team isn't "gonna shut the door" on Beck returning, but Arizona might have to turn to their fourth quarterback of the season.
